summary: Two climbers (a 23-year-old male and his friend) rappelled the Red Guard climb on Redgarden Wall in the wrong spot around 7 p.m. and became stuck; two friends attempted to help for several hours before they called 911; Rocky Mountain Rescue Group performed a technical rescue and evacuated both without incident or injury.
location: Red Guard route, Redgarden Wall, Eldorado Canyon State Park
responding_agency: Boulder County Sheriff's Office; Rocky Mountain Fire Authority; Rocky Mountain Rescue Group
